title: Office work and craftsmanship
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a munkával való elégedettségről, a stresszről és a szakmák megbecsültségéről.

scenes.description: It is eight o'clock in the evening in a large open-plan office. Most of the desks are empty, but a young woman wearing a headset is still staring at two computer screens full of charts. Next to her keyboard there is a half-eaten takeaway salad and a phone showing several missed calls. She looks stressed and is rubbing her neck.

In a small, sunny workshop, a carpenter in his thirties is finishing a wooden chair. Tools are hanging on the wall, and the floor is covered in wood shavings. A teenage apprentice is watching closely as the carpenter shows him how to make the surface smooth. Both of them seem calm and focused, and the carpenter is smiling.

prompts: Compare the two working environments and how the people might feel.
Why do fewer young people choose manual or vocational jobs today?
followUpQuestions: Why do so many office workers suffer from stress and burnout?
Should vocational training be more respected in Hungary? Why?
Should employers limit how much overtime people can do? How?
Would you prefer a well-paid office job or a job where you make things with your hands? Why?

usefulPhrases.en: She appears to be under a lot of stress.
usefulPhrases.hu: Úgy tűnik, nagy stressz alatt van.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text:
Both pictures show people at work, but the environments and the people's feelings couldn't be more different. In the first one, it's eight in the evening in a huge open-plan office. Most of the desks are empty, but a young woman wearing a headset is still staring at two screens full of charts. There's a half-eaten salad next to her keyboard and several missed calls on her phone, so she's obviously stressed. In the second picture, a carpenter is finishing a wooden chair in a small, sunny workshop, while a teenage apprentice is watching him closely. They both seem calm and focused.
I'd say the carpenter is much more satisfied, because he can see and touch the result of his work, whereas the woman's work probably never really ends. For me, a satisfying job is one where you feel useful and have some control over your time. It's a pity that fewer young people choose vocational jobs today. Many parents think only a degree leads to success, even though good craftsmen are in huge demand and often earn very well.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Would you prefer a well-paid office job or a job where you make things with your hands? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Honestly, something in between. I enjoy working with computers, but I couldn't sit in an office until eight every evening. A job like architecture, where you design something real, would suit me best.

notes: Összefüggő témakifejtés: mindkét munkakörnyezet leírása után a vizsgázó érvel arról, mitől elégedett valaki a munkájával, kitér arra, miért választanak kevesebben szakmát, a visszakérdezésre pedig árnyalt, saját pályaterveihez kötött választ ad.
Szókincs: pontos, változatos szavak (open-plan office, headset, apprentice, vocational jobs, craftsmen, in huge demand) és jól felépített érvelés (I'd say, For me, It's a pity that).
Nyelvhelyesség: változatos B2-es szerkezetek hibátlanul – 'couldn't be more different', Present Continuous a leírásban, 'whereas', 'even though' és 'would suit me best'.
Érdemes megtanulni: „couldn't be more different”, „see and touch the result of his work”, „in huge demand”, „would suit me best”.
